drawings.description: figure : un quadrilatère $s_0 s_1 s_2 s_3$, de côtés orientés $u_0, u_1, u_2, u_3$
drawings.notes: Quadrilateral s0 s1 s2 s3 with sides u0 = s0->s1, u1 = s1->s2, u2 = s2->s3, u3 = s3->s0, each arrowed at its end, as on the page.

drawings.description: sous le texte, cinq croquis de quadrilatères : un quadrilatère ouvert, un quadrilatère croisé en « Z », deux droites sécantes portant quatre points, un trapèze avec ses diagonales, un quadrilatère aplati avec ses diagonales
drawings.notes: Five pencil sketches, left to right and top to bottom: an open quadrilateral (three sides, a tick at the free end); a crossed quadrilateral in Z; lines through four points, two of them thickened; a trapezoid with its two diagonals and a vertical stroke from a dot on the top side; a flattened quadrilateral with its diagonals (bottom left, with a faint stroke under it). Disagreement (minor): the "deux droites sécantes" sketch shows three lines (two long lines and a third through two of the points), with two short thick strokes between the points.

drawings.description: figure : quatre côtés consécutifs $u_{i-1}, u_i, u_{i+1}, u_{i+2}$ d'un polygone, sommets $s_{i-1}, \ldots, s_{i+3}$
drawings.kind: polygonal line (consecutive sides of a polygon)
drawings.notes: Four consecutive sides u_{i-1}, u_i, u_{i+1}, u_{i+2} of a polygon, vertices s_{i-1} ... s_{i+3}, labels placed as on the page; no arrows.

drawings.description: figure : le quadrilatère de côtés $u_0, u_1, u_2, u_3$ et ses deux diagonales fléchées
drawings.notes: Quadrilateral with sides u0 (top left), u1 (top right, arrowed into the right vertex), u2 (bottom right), u3 (bottom left, a separate stroke that does not close the figure), and its two diagonals arrowed (horizontal one to the left, vertical one upwards). A stray dot below the figure is left out. The transcription locates this figure correctly; the other sketches of the page (two lines with s0, s2, s3 at the top; vectors u, v and a pentagon with all its diagonals at the bottom) are covered by notes, not marks.

drawings.description: figure : quatre côtés consécutifs $u_{i-2}, \ldots, u_{i+1}$ annotés des $\lambda_{i-2}, \ldots, \lambda_{i+2}$, avec des ratures
drawings.notes: Four consecutive sides u_{i-2} (faint, arrowed at its free end), u_{i-1}, u_i, u_{i+1}, with the heavy vertices. Only the labels that read clearly are drawn: lambda_{i-2}, lambda_{i-1} u_{i-2}, u_{i-1}, u_i, u_{i+1}, lambda_{i+1}, lambda_{i+2}. The overwritten vertex labels (lambda_{i-1}, lambda_i, the struck index under lambda_{i-2}, the overinked lambda at the bottom right and the lambda_{i+1} under the bottom side) are left out.

drawings.description: figure : $s_0$ et les côtés $u_0, u_1, u_2$ fléchés
drawings.notes: From s0, the sides u0 (horizontal), u1 and u2, each arrowed. A struck symbol at the top left of the crop is left out.

drawings.description: croquis en marge gauche du paragraphe : la ligne brisée $s_0 s_1 s_2 s_3$, côtés $u_0, \ldots, u_3$, $u_0$ et $u_3$ horizontaux
drawings.notes: The broken line s0 s1 s2 s3 with arrowed sides u0 ... u3, u0 and u3 horizontal, as the transcription says.
